title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® DNA Food Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform sample lysis
steps.instruction: Carry out the lysis of the food sample according to the NucleoMag® DNA Food user manual, reducing the sample input to 50 mg when appropriate for the sample type.

steps.title: Fill buffer reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑well Buffer Reservoir with the reagents specified in the kit’s table.

steps.title: Prepare magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the NucleoMag® B‑Beads by vortexing and place the bead suspension in Position A1 of the 2 mL Tube Rack.

steps.title: Load instrument deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the displayed positions in the protocol.

steps.title: Place lysates on magnet
steps.instruction: Put the Square‑well Block containing the lysates onto the Magnetic Module and start the run.

steps.title: Binding step
steps.instruction: Execute the automated DNA binding step as programmed on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Wash 1
steps.instruction: Perform the first automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Wash 2
steps.instruction: Perform the second automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Wash 3
steps.instruction: Perform the third automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow a delay for drying the beads after the final wash.

steps.title: Elution step
steps.instruction: Carry out the automated elution of DNA from the beads.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol archive and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol .py file in the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated DNA extraction.
